## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2021-02-02: Form-of TRA (Exchanges) filed as Exhibit 10.2 to S-1/A
- 2021-02-09: Up-C IPO closes; executed Tax Receivable Agreement (Exchanges) dated February 9, 2021 paying 85% of net cash tax savings on Section 754 basis step-ups from future LLC Unit exchanges by the Vanderhook Parties and Viant Technology Equity Plan LLC (10-K Exhibit 10.3, filed March 23, 2021)

#### First liability recognition

- 2025-12-31: FY2025 10-K records first TRA liability of $12.4M and a $10.9M TRA expense following valuation-allowance release; status remains in force

## Explanation

Viant Technology Inc. executed an 85% Up-C Tax Receivable Agreement (Exchanges) at its February 9, 2021 IPO close, paying the continuing LLC members (the Vanderhook Parties and the Viant Technology Equity Plan LLC) 85% of net cash tax savings on Section 754 basis step-ups arising from future exchanges of LLC Units for Class A common stock. From 2021 through FY2024 Viant held a full valuation allowance on the underlying deferred tax assets and disclosed an unrecorded TRA liability rising from $10.3M to $11.2M. In FY2025 Viant concluded it was now more likely than not that the deferred tax assets would be realized, released the valuation allowance, and recorded a $12.4M TRA liability with a $10.9M TRA expense; this is a payment-status transition, not a contract-life-cycle event. No amendments, restatements, or terminations have been filed. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing record and the credit-agreement and LLC-agreement amendment carve-outs.
